network.name: KiteAI Testnet
network.note: Testnet only. Gas token is KITE (18 decimals). Chain id, RPC and explorer from Kite's own network-information page (docs.gokite.ai, Kite Chain > Getting Started > Network Information), chain id confirmed live by eth_chainId on 2026-10-24.

paymentToken.verifiedOnChain: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() recomputes from ("PYUSD", "1", 2368, address); contract carries transferWithAuthorization(address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32,uint8,bytes32,bytes32) and authorizationState; claimTo(address) mints CLAIM_AMOUNT = 10 PYUSD for testing.
paymentToken.note: Test token. Kite MAINNET pays in USDC.e (bridged), 6 decimals, domain ("Bridged USDC (Kite AI)", "2") — see packages/mcp-server/src/self-settled.ts.

TouchstoneAttestationV2.adminNote: TESTNET VALIDATION ONLY — Foundry/Anvil's well-known public default test account, not a key generated for this project. A real mainnet deployment must pass the owner's hardware-wallet address as admin_; there is no way to change it afterwards.

liveValidation.description: One real postPrint signed with `cast wallet sign --data` against standard EIP-712 JSON (independent of the contract's own hashing), dry-run with eth_call, broadcast, and confirmed with isPosted. Same content as the Base Sepolia and Arc Testnet validations.

paidToolSettlement.description: Live test payments on Kite testnet, settled by this repo's own server code (packages/mcp-server/src/self-settled.ts: @x402/evm's reference exact-scheme facilitator, gas paid by a settler key), buyer = the test buyer, payee = the treasury of the time, below (replaced as payTo by 0xB514882859f43DbF3df664C899D707f649E0CF4A on 2026-11-26).
paidToolSettlement.gasNote: Average 71,352 gas per settlement (the first is higher: first-time balance storage). Testnet gas price was about 27.8 gwei; Kite mainnet read 175 gwei on 2026-10-24, about 0.0125 KITE per settlement.
